scenicChapters.title: Fort site and civil settlement of Boehming → Fort site of Burgsalach
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 30 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-eining-weinberg-wachtturm-und-hei.story: From Neustadt an der Donau it runs 168 km to Neustadt an der Donau; allow about 2 h 54 of riding. The stops in between: Fort site and civil settlement of Kösching, Fort site and civil settlement of Boehming, Fort site of Burgsalach and back through Fort site and civil settlement of Boehming. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

legend-joshua-tree-park-boulevard.slogan: Joshua Tree Park Boulevard – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-joshua-tree-park-boulevard.story: curated scenic road. desert, granite formations, Joshua trees. From Joshua Tree it runs 76 km to the finish; allow about 1 h 23 of riding. The highest point is about 1,100 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Joshua Tree Park Boulevard
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 19 km this is Joshua Tree Park Boulevard, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
